idea: On AK's go (1 Nov 2026): Short 2 of two. Karnataka vs Tamil Nadu on October 2026 GST, three rounds: growth in October (18.4% v 3.2%), growth April to October (12.2% v -2.3%), GST ID numbers (Tamil Nadu 12.9 lakh v Karnataka 11.6 lakh). Score Karnataka 2, Tamil Nadu 1. The post-settlement round (receipts +20% v +15%) was cut for length and is kept for a separate Short.
alt_title: Karnataka vs Tamil Nadu: Who Won October's GST?
description: Karnataka vs Tamil Nadu, three rounds of October 2026 GST data (GSTN, provisional). Final score: Karnataka 2, Tamil Nadu 1.

Growth on October 2025: Karnataka 18.4%, Tamil Nadu 3.2% (Karnataka ahead; domestic GST)
Growth, April to October: Karnataka 12.2%, Tamil Nadu -2.3% (Karnataka ahead)
GST ID numbers (GSTINs) at 31 Oct 2026: Karnataka 11.6 lakh, Tamil Nadu 12.9 lakh (Tamil Nadu ahead; central and state formations added, our calculation)
Closing map: October GST growth, every state. Blank: Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar, Mizoram (under ₹50 crore in October 2025). The table shows how much, not why.
source: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), 'Gross and Net GST revenue collections for the month of October, 2026', posted 1 Nov 2026, provisional. Round 1: growth of domestic GST recorded in the state on October 2025, our calculation from Table 3. Round 2: Table 4, April to October 2026 over 2025. Round 3: GST identification numbers (GSTINs) under central and state formations at 31 Oct 2026, Table 4, added by us, in lakh. GST is recorded where the taxpayer is registered.
